summary.text: Morgan Cephas is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 192, which she has represented since December 2016, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Cephas assumed office in the House on December 1, 2016, succeeding Lynwood Savage.
Ballotpedia also lists her as having run for election to the U.S. House in Pennsylvania's 3rd Congressional District; she did not appear on the Democratic primary ballot on May 19, 2026.
